editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out the world has completely changed while you were taking a nap. That is exactly what happens to two guys who get frozen in the 1960s to save one of their lives. They are in a huge rush and basically run away from the law to get into those freezing pods. It feels like a weird mix of a crime movie and a sci-fi story. You get to see their confusion as they try to figure out why everything looks different and how people act in this new time. The vibe is a bit dreamy and strange, making you feel as lost as the main characters are.

You will probably love how the actors play the shock of waking up in the future. The pacing is steady, though some parts feel a bit slow because the movie focuses more on feelings than big explosions. One downside is that the sci-fi elements are simple, but it works for the story. If you enjoy stories about time jumps and second chances, you should definitely give this a try. You can find it by renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the end, the men have to deal with the fact that the people they loved have aged or moved on. They realize they cannot simply go back to their old lives because those lives no longer exist. They eventually accept their new reality and decide to move forward together. It wraps up with a bittersweet feeling, showing that while science can save your body, it cannot stop time from changing your heart.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about time travel and lost love.
